name: Anax
description: King of Akros who challenged Rhordon and was grievously wounded.

description_citations.text: "Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax runs around the gymnasium and the palace grounds on the morning of the Setessans' audience.
timeline.quote: He ran past the rack of spears and swords

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In the bathhouse, Timoteus mocks Anax, asking whether his plan is to run away when the Setessan army is bored of talking.
timeline.quote: When the Setessan army is bored of talking, is your plan to run away?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Setessan ambassador fails to reach an accord with King Athanas and hints they may take it up with his heir, Timoteus.
timeline.quote: We may take this up with your heir.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas declares that Anax is his eldest, and the ambassador seems unimpressed by Anax.
timeline.quote: This is Anax, my eldest.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas looks proudly at Timoteus and contemptuously at Anax in front of the soldiers.
timeline.quote: and he did nothing to conceal his contempt.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax concludes in a lesson with Georgios that his father may not like him and that a king's choice of heir matters; Georgios hints a king could change the inheritance law.
timeline.quote: Does the king have the authority to change laws?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax meets Zotikos in the gymnasium sand pit; Zotikos teaches him weight exercises and the apron-running drill.
timeline.quote: Plant your feet at shoulder width.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax asks to meet Zotikos each evening, and Zotikos agrees after a calculating pause.
timeline.quote: Zotikos considered for a moment too long, and gave a calculating smile.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zotikos admits he helps Anax because he is the prince, wants to surpass his father's station, and thought Anax was looking for a friend.
timeline.quote: And it seemed like you were looking for a friend.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax tells Zotikos to drop his titles in the gymnasium, where he is simply Anax.
timeline.quote: I am Anax.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Georgios reminds Anax that the Iroan Games come in four months and he must compete; Timoteus has begun training for the pankration.
timeline.quote: the Iroan Games will take place in four months

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax resolves to attack boldly at his rival's strength and tells Zotikos he has some ideas.
timeline.quote: I have some ideas.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax visits the champion Sinon and asks to train with him for the Games, but Sinon refuses since he already trains Timoteus.
timeline.quote: I only have time for one pupil.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax and Zotikos spar at the gymnasium; Zotikos beats him with an arm lock but cannot explain how.
timeline.quote: "Maybe I could help. Let's get everything out of the middle."

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Georgios suggests the advisor Kaletor, a former pankration competitor, as a teacher.
timeline.quote: He competed in the pankration for several years.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax asks Kaletor to train him; learning Sinon trains his brother, Kaletor agrees with fire in his eyes.
timeline.quote: "In that case, I will be honored to help you."

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kaletor begins training Anax and Zotikos at night, teaching Anax to close and ground opponents and to use joint locks.
timeline.quote: Kaletor was true to his word, and began to teach Anax and Zotikos that very night.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax nearly cripples Zotikos with a kneebar and Kaletor confirms Sinon crippled him that way.
timeline.quote: "It was Sinon, wasn't it?"

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kaletor teaches the heel hook and makes Anax promise not to hurt anyone with it.
timeline.quote: Promise me you won't hurt anyone with it.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax wins his first two bouts of the junior pankration division before a packed stadium.
timeline.quote: Anax's first two bouts were easy.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax draws Timoteus, who opens with strikes; Anax closes and takes him to the ground.
timeline.quote: He grabbed his brother's kicking thigh and opposite shoulder and shoved, and like that the two were on the ground.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax baits Timoteus into the kneebar that crippled Kaletor, reverses it into a heel hook, and Timoteus submits.
timeline.quote: Timoteus went for it without a second thought.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax publicly rebukes Timoteus for trying to cripple him, winning the crowd's respect.
timeline.quote: But who would want to serve a king who crippled his own brother?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax loses his next bout but has won the crowd's respect.
timeline.quote: He lost his next bout to a tall young man who was about to come of age, and was stronger and more skilled.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Timoteus is publicly whipped for treason for trying to cripple his future king.
timeline.quote: King Athanas was furious with his second son, and had insisted.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The king tells Anax a marriage to Cymede is being arranged.
timeline.quote: We are considering a young woman named Cymede.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Rhordon, aided by Mogis, impales King Anax; Elspeth saves Anax, and Rhordon is washed away by the river.
timeline.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Revel Anax dies, Cymede is missing, and their niece Taranika becomes regent.
timeline.quote: the responsibility of leadership fell to their niece, Taranika , who serves as regent

citation.text: "Akros", section "Uncertain succession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Silenced like all Theros gods, Mogis circumvents the restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon in a duel with Anax shortly before the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: he circumvented this restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon during a duel with Anax

citation.text: "Mogis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis of other gods' influence, Purphoros and the others summon champions from the Underworld, Purphoros choosing Anax.
timeline.quote: Purphoros’s champion was Anax , former king of Akros .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The nyxborn explains that it was sent to serve the governor but that Pilun no longer serves the true king, and it cannot free itself.
timeline.quote: this governor seems to no longer serve the true king.

citation.text: "The Hero of Iroas" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: When the sirens tire and drop, Aesrias kills them; the nyxborn's blessing fades and he resolves to inform the king of Pilun's secession.
timeline.quote: The journey to the Kolophon to inform the king of Pilun's secession and my encounter with a nyxborn will be dangerous.

citation.text: "The Hero of Iroas" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Daxos and Elspeth realize their feelings after the victory celebration.
timeline.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realized their feelings for each other

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aesrias sets out to tell King Anax of Tynthal's secession.
timeline.quote: His next quest would be to go to Akros to inform King Anax of Tynthal's secession

citation.text: "Aesrias", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos and his forces lay siege to Akros; Anax fights Rhordon, who is aided by Mogis, and is impaled.
timeline.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth saves Anax and Rhordon is washed away by Keranos's river elemental.
timeline.quote: Elspeth stepped forward and saved Anax

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax insists the victory celebration continue, which Xenagos uses to become the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: This celebration was used by Xenagos to become the Great Revel he needed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax dies within two years, possibly of his injuries.
timeline.quote: He died sometime in the following two years, possibly due to his injuries.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the war between the gods, Purphoros reforges Anax into a demigod who can only say 'Cymede'.
timeline.quote: During the war between the gods, Purphoros transformed Anax, reforging him into a demigod who can't think of anything but victory.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos arrive in Akros, which is besieged by Mogis's minotaurs, and meet the imprisoned Xenagos.
timeline.quote: They found the city encircled by Mogis’s minotaurs and a massive barricade cutting off reinforcements.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax challenges Rhordon while Cymede and Daxos unleash the Deyda River with Keranos's might; Rhordon's horde is swept away and Anax wounded.
timeline.quote: Rhordon and his minotaur horde were swept away, but Anax was left grievously wounded.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At dawn Xenagos rises into Nyx; Elspeth is branded a traitor and vanishes into the wilderness.
timeline.quote: At dawn, Xenagos rose shimmering into the starry Nyx, leaving his mortal life behind.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Some gods circumvent the Silence: Keranos aids Cymede, and Iroas and Mogis appear above the duel of Anax and Rhordon, where Keranos's steam elemental kills Rhordon.
timeline.quote: Keranos retaliated by creating a draconic steam elemental from the river

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
